scope: Read-only final code review of v0.5 losses, selected-evaluation resume, full-condition freeze, local trusted artifact verification, packing and fixture tests.
verdict: No remaining high-priority bug found in reviewed code. Deterministic pack failure reported during review is now fixed in both shared and frozen code.

resolved_previous_findings.evidence: train.py:538-539 now passes config.get(training_objective) to MeasuredTrainer; None is only normalized once in trainer. Existing no-objective configurations retain default model dropout behavior.

resolved_previous_findings.evidence: train.py:624-631 stores all selected checkpoint file hashes; resume_evaluation:661-670 and comparison.replay_selection:164-174 compare all files and weight digest before use.

resolved_previous_findings.evidence: verify_results.py:214-219 checks exact configured seed key set.

resolved_previous_findings.evidence: comparison.replay_selection:140-163 checks each history identity and exact epoch sequence, recomputes each best epoch; full shared-LR and primary selection recomputed at132-139 before freeze_comparison.

resolved_previous_findings.evidence: train.py:129-131 accumulates detached tensors; scalar conversion occurs at588-591 after trial.

resolved_previous_findings.issue: Pack completion calls integer file size
resolved_previous_findings.status: fixed in shared code; frozen-copy state reflected in unresolved_findings

reviewed_invariants: train.two_view_terms computes mean of both example-mean CEs plus separately returned symmetric KL averaging directions, summing class terms and averaging original examples; both logits remain differentiable.
dropout_2view and rdrop planned configs have identical two views and four p0.1 dropout settings; only KL weight differs (0 vs1). Baseline is one view and four p0 fields.
MeasuredTrainer.compute_loss delegates to ordinary Trainer outside model.training and for one-view baseline. This preserves ordinary dev CE and saved-checkpoint CE reload equality.

Current gradient accumulation is one. Local Transformers5.19 training_step and compute_loss source confirm no gradient-accumulation scale discrepancy for the prescribed single-device route. Future GA>1 or distributed use would need explicit custom loss scaling review and is outside this comparison.

All three condition roots copy exactly derived parent inputs; check_input_files and replay_selection compare their hashes against expected_inputs generated from trusted parent code/config/data, not artifact-declared expectations alone.

comparison.run defers evaluations for all methods; replay_selection completes for all, freeze_comparison rejects any seed report or evaluation-start marker, then each condition resumes selected evaluation.

Saved comparison selection is recomputed from dev-only means and condition order; hash ties condition selection records to the global freeze; verification checks training_finished <= comparison_frozen <= evaluation_started.

Artifact verification invokes trusted ROOT/verify_results.py via sys.executable with NYAMURU_EXPERIMENT_ROOT selecting derived condition inputs. The downloaded train/verify/comparison Python files are hashed as data rather than executed.
Received per-condition verification uses --read-only and compares reports/verification.json with reconstructed metrics instead of writing outputs.
independent_acceptance_eligible=False propagates into all condition configs and suppresses target_assessment; test73 and older sets remain regression-only.
Existing source/labels, dataset bytes, no-truncation encoding and per-source/family invariants remain in shared validation path.

Packaging retains selected model contents, all reports, trial JSON/JSONL diagnostic files and all declared inputs. The parent fixture exercises three roots, eighteen trial runs, nine selected checkpoints, prediction recomputation and read-only verification; its completion was not independently executed in this review.

test_scope_assessment.test_comparison: Covers symmetric KL numerical formula, batch-size normalization, nonzero finite gradients, invalid objective cases, tiny ModernBERT train/eval/reload, one-vs-two forward counts, dev-only method selection/ties/missing methods and independent-acceptance suppression.
test_scope_assessment.smoke_comparison: Uses a tiny CPU ModernBERT and placeholder tokenizer in an isolated fixture; copies unchanged real data but changes fixture model/epochs/batch only; exercises actual shared coordinator run/pack/trusted verification; checks both downloaded artifact and real input hashes remain unchanged.
test_scope_assessment.limits: I performed static reads and local installed-API source inspection only. Parent owns execution evidence and final bundle regeneration; no T4/CUDA performance or real-model accuracy was checked.
